'''TK-571''' was a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
Sometime following [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], TK-571 was part of a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] unit that guarded a statue of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] installed in front of the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during that [[Standard year/Legends|year's]] [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] celebrations.

==Behind the scenes==
TK-571 was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. He made appearances during the Empire Day live events of [[2009]] through [[2011]].
